levels.name: Starter
levels.summary: Beginner from zero: greetings, names, numbers and survival phrases.
levels.summary_ar: مبتدئ من الصفر: التحيات، الأسماء، الأرقام وعبارات النجاة.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.summary: Very basic communication about yourself and simple everyday needs.
levels.summary_ar: تواصل أساسي جدًا عن نفسك واحتياجاتك اليومية البسيطة.

levels.name: Elementary
levels.summary: Everyday communication: routines, plans, simple exchanges.
levels.summary_ar: تواصل يومي: الروتين، الخطط، التبادلات البسيطة.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.summary: Independent everyday communication: handling problems, services and travel.
levels.summary_ar: تواصل يومي مستقل: التعامل مع المشكلات والخدمات والسفر.

levels.name: Upper-intermediate
levels.summary: Fluent, increasingly nuanced communication: opinions, arguments, work.
levels.summary_ar: تواصل طليق ودقيق بشكل متزايد: الآراء والحجج والعمل.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.summary: Advanced natural communication: academic and professional nuance.
levels.summary_ar: تواصل متقدم وطبيعي: دقة أكاديمية ومهنية.

units.title: First words
units.summary: Hello, names, numbers and asking someone to repeat.

units.title: About me
units.summary: Where you're from, where you live and what you do.

units.title: Out and about
units.summary: Ordering food and drinks, prices and polite requests.

units.title: Everyday life
units.summary: Routines, habits and how often you do things.

units.title: Travel
units.summary: Handling travel problems and getting what you need.

units.title: Getting things done
units.summary: Appointments, polite requests and changing plans.

units.title: Views and arguments
units.summary: Giving opinions, agreeing and disagreeing with nuance.

lessons.title: Hello! What's your name?
canDo: I can say hello and goodbye.
I can say my name and ask someone's name.
I can ask "How are you?" and answer.

lessons.title: Numbers, age and phone numbers
canDo: I can say my age and phone number.
I can hear the difference between 13 and 30.
I can ask someone to repeat.

lessons.title: Meeting a new classmate
canDo: I can say where I'm from, where I live and what I study.
I can ask simple questions with do you…?

lessons.title: At the café
canDo: I can order food and drinks politely.
I can answer a server's questions and ask the price.

lessons.title: A typical day
canDo: I can describe my daily routine.
I can say how often I do things.
I can find a time to meet by comparing routines.

lessons.title: Plans for the weekend
canDo: I can talk about my plans and arrangements.
I can make and accept suggestions.
I can agree on a time and place.

lessons.title: My flight has been cancelled
canDo: I can explain a travel problem clearly.
I can understand options and make a decision.
I can use the present perfect for news and results.

lessons.title: Making an appointment
canDo: I can make and change an appointment by phone.
I can make polite requests of different strength.
I can use since and for correctly.

lessons.title: Working from home: where do you stand?
canDo: I can give and justify an opinion.
I can acknowledge another view before disagreeing.
I can link contrasting ideas with although, however, on the other hand.

lessons.title: The job interview
canDo: I can describe my experience and responsibilities.
I can answer "Tell me about a difficult decision" with a clear structure.
I can use have been + -ing for ongoing experience.

lessons.title: Seminar: should phones be banned?
canDo: I can make hedged, evidence-based claims.
I can concede a point and challenge an argument respectfully.
I can reframe a debate.
